articles.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
articles.snippet: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

articles.title: Bitcoin, stocks and gold traders getting nervous, and volatility gauges are surging
US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
articles.snippet: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

articles.title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
articles.snippet: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
articles.snippet: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.
